steps.en: A scheduled job starts every morning for the classified vehicle report
steps.id: Job terjadwal berjalan tiap pagi untuk laporan classified vehicle

steps.en: The report lists every notice of classified vehicles, not just that day's
steps.id: Laporan memuat semua notice classified vehicle, bukan hanya milik hari itu
steps.why_en: It covers all notices of this type ever issued rather than a daily slice; the story gives no time window.
steps.why_id: Isinya semua notice tipe ini sepanjang waktu, bukan irisan harian; story tidak menyebut jendela waktu.

steps.en: Each row shows vehicle, offence time, offence code, car park and amount
steps.id: Tiap baris menampilkan kendaraan, waktu offence, kode offence, car park dan jumlah

steps.en: The report shows the owner's name and the furnished driver's name
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan nama owner dan nama furnished driver
steps.why_en: The report has no owner or furnished driver name at all; only vehicle and offence details are listed.
steps.why_id: Laporan sama sekali tidak memuat nama owner atau furnished driver; hanya detail kendaraan dan offence.

steps.en: A report file is generated each day
The report goes to the OIC dashboard for follow-up
steps.id: Laporan diteruskan ke dashboard OIC untuk ditindaklanjuti
steps.why_en: The report is emailed instead of shown on a dashboard, and the production email settings appear to block it.
steps.why_id: Laporan dikirim lewat email, bukan tampil di dashboard, dan pengaturan email produksi tampaknya memblokirnya.
